work_hospital.tut.title: Hospital tutorial
work_hospital.tut.granted: Tutorial done: you got the Nurse rank. Good work!
work_hospital.tut.welcome_title: Welcome to the All Saints ER!
work_hospital.tut.welcome_text: This short walk takes you through the rooms of the department. At the end you get the Nurse rank; until then you cannot treat patients. The Hospital category of the F1 help explains everything in detail.
work_hospital.tut.stretcher_text: Press E here to get a hospital trolley and push it at once. Push an empty hospital trolley here and E returns it.
work_hospital.tut.exam_centre_text: Take the Resident and Physician exams here. Resident needs 2 hours on duty as a nurse, Physician 4 hours as a resident and 20 closed cases.
work_hospital.tut.pc_text: The computers by the desk (E) have the patient registry, the department, the supplies, the communication and the document archive; documentation (history, status, epicrisis, diagnoses) can be recorded only here. The tablet: J or /sbo.
work_hospital.tut.corridor_text: Patients brought by ambulance land on these corridor spots on a hospital trolley. After triage a treating doctor takes them.
work_hospital.tut.shock_text: For critical patients. The patient is put on the wall monitor by itself. Only here: RSI, chest drain, pelvic binder, ventilation, FAST, 12-lead ECG.
work_hospital.tut.wound_text: Irrigation, local anaesthesia, suture, dressing. Do not forget tetanus!
work_hospital.tut.cast_text: No cast without an X-ray. Pain relief before a reduction, check circulation, movement and sensation after the cast.
work_hospital.tut.ct_text: One patient at a time, the others on a queue. Push the trolley here and the patient slides into the scanner. The image also shows on the wall monitor.
work_hospital.tut.xray_text: Stand here behind the lead wall for the exposure. For limbs pick the right side!
work_hospital.tut.surgery_text: Push the patient sent for an operation here. The NPC surgeon operates; afterwards the patient comes out on a new trolley in the corridor.
work_hospital.tut.icu_text: For ventilated, unstable patients. Set the ventilator, noradrenaline and sedation in the patient panel; rounds every 5 minutes.
work_hospital.tut.ward_text: For a ward admission push the patient here. If they worsen you get an alert and can take them back into care.
work_hospital.tut.morgue_text: A physician records the death, then push the body here on the trolley. The death certificate is written at the drop.
work_hospital.tut.transfer_text: For a transfer (S1/S2) the ambulance crew takes the patient over from the hospital trolley here.
work_hospital.tut.ranks_text: Nurse → Resident → Physician → Chief. Every intervention gives points, paid at the end of the duty. As a nurse you give medicines only when they are ordered.
work_hospital.tut.done_text: Press Enter to get the Nurse rank. You can repeat the tutorial later with /hosptutorial.
